_comment: Character registry (ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINTS.md §5). A dialogue line's 'speaker' is an id resolved here to a display name, a default portrait and a gender. Seeded from the speakers in the eleven v1 dialogue files; new characters arrive with their content. 'gender' is one of male | female | player | none — 'player' means the character follows the player's choice of Patch's gender (sys.patch_gender), 'none' means pronouns never refer to them.
